ui_label: Horizontal grid cell with a spectral reduced gaussian grid type.
description: Reduced Gaussian grid of a T62 spectral atmosphere model, with triangular truncation and a quadratic transform grid (3T+1 rule, to avoid aliasing). There are 96 Gaussian latitudes. The number of longitude points per latitude goes from 30 near the poles to 192 between about 42S and 42N, for a total of 14,876 cells (the full 192 x 96 grid would have 18,432). The Y resolution varies from 1.84964 to 1.86526 degrees. Model output is written on the full Gaussian grid.
